summary: Tested JWT email/password auth end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests passing (login success sets httpOnly access_token+refresh_token cookies, invalid/nonexistent user return 401, /auth/me works authenticated, /auth/logout clears cookies, register creates user & lowercases email, duplicate register returns 400/409, forgot-password returns 200 for both known and unknown emails (no user enumeration), reset-password with invalid token returns 4xx, brute-force lockout triggers 429/403 within 6 attempts on a throwaway user). Frontend: /admin/login renders email+password form, Sign In button, 'Forgot your password?' link, 'Continue with Google' button, and 'Sign Up' toggle. Invalid credentials display 'Invalid email or password' error inline + toast. Valid admin login (admin@nicnackables.com / NicNack2024!) redirects to /admin dashboard with 'Welcome back, Admin!' toast. /forgot-password renders and submits with success screen ('Check Your Email'). /reset-password?token=... renders new+confirm password fields. Admin auto-seeding verified via successful login.

critical_bug_found_and_fixed.issue: ForgotPassword.jsx and ResetPassword.jsx used imports '../../components/ui/button|input|label' but the files live in src/pages/ (only one level below src/), so '../../' resolved OUTSIDE src/, breaking Webpack compilation. The whole app served a 'Compiled with problems' error overlay - /admin/login was completely unreachable.
critical_bug_found_and_fixed.fix: Changed imports from '../../components/ui/...' to '../components/ui/...' in both files. Webpack recompiled successfully. Confirmed with 'webpack compiled successfully' in supervisor logs and full UI flow now working.

passed_tests: POST /api/auth/login -> 200 + httpOnly access_token & refresh_token cookies for admin
UI invalid login -> inline error + toast 'Invalid email or password'
UI valid login -> redirect /admin dashboard, welcome toast
UI /forgot-password submit -> 'Check Your Email' confirmation screen
UI /reset-password?token=... loads with new+confirm password fields
action_items: None blocking. Optional: E1 may consider moving ForgotPassword.jsx/ResetPassword.jsx under src/pages/admin/ for consistency with AdminLogin.jsx and re-verify imports.
Optional: consider a subtler success wording on /forgot-password (currently reveals the email address the user typed - low risk but low value).
critical_code_review_comments: Bug (fixed by tester): incorrect '../../components/ui/...' import depth in ForgotPassword.jsx & ResetPassword.jsx broke the entire frontend build. Must add a lint rule / smoke test to prevent recurrence.
Password reveal button works, form validation on Sign Up not tested exhaustively (mismatched passwords, weak password) - E1 should ensure server-side password policy enforcement.
Brute-force lockout locks by (ip, email) or similar - lockout does not affect legitimate users from another IP, confirmed indirectly. Recommend documenting the exact lockout key.
seed_data_creation: Registered throwaway TEST_* users during pytest run (for register + brute-force tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: JWT auth is fully working. Import-path bug in ForgotPassword.jsx/ResetPassword.jsx was fixed by tester. Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_auth.py is reusable. Brute-force test uses a freshly-registered throwaway user so admin lockout is avoided. All UI test-ids on /admin/login could be strengthened - most selectors currently rely on input[type=email/password] and button[type=submit]; adding data-testid attributes would make future automation more robust.
